messages:
incident-bot: PAGER — latency-slo-alert: p99 > 3s for Redwood Hosted API (route: /v1/generate) — current window 10m — paging sara_oncall :rotating_light:

incident-bot: Automatic severity: Sev2 (SLO breach, customer impact)

sara_oncall: just saw the page, digging in. pulling p95/p99 dashboards now — can someone grab the live tail logs for the streaming workers?

raj_engineer: on it, grabbing tail from logs-gateway-*. streaming stalls correlate with long kernel stalls on some gpus. past 12m saw multiple stalls.

miguel_infra: looking at infra graphs — we have a cluster of 3 GPU nodes with rising GPU memory ECC errors and temp climbs. hostnames: gnode-12, gnode-13, gnode-14.

emily_support: CSMs flagged elevated latency for 3 customers, one on Dedicated capacity. Not yet on the status page. We should draft a short note if customer impact confirmed.

sara_oncall: good. raj, can you paste the log snippets and the nvidia-smi outputs?

raj_engineer: paste below:
```
[2026-03-14T10:01:23Z] worker-stream-7 | STREAMER stall detected, wait 3120ms, kvcache hit=0
[2026-03-14T10:02:01Z] gnode-12 | kernel: GPU 0: migrating pages due to ECC errors, corrected=1245, uncorrected=2
[2026-03-14T10:02:04Z] gnode-12 | nvidia-smi: temp=92C, pwr=320W, fan=90%
```

miguel_infra: also seeing thrashing on NVLINK on gnode-13. driver logs show repeated GPU resets: `/var/log/messages` snippet:
```
Mar 14 10:03:11 gnode-13 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65): 79, PID=0, GPU has fallen off the bus
Mar 14 10:03:12 gnode-13 kernel: NVRM: GPU at 0000:65:00.0 has a corrected ECC error
```

sara_oncall: ok action list: 1) isolate affected nodes from serving 2) drain GPU pods on those nodes 3) failover traffic to warm pool /dedicated-backups 4) notify affected customers 5) escalate to hw_oncall for hardware triage. Who's taking node isolation?

raj_engineer: I can run the drain and cordon. kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data gnode-12; cordon gnode-13; staging throttling policy to route away.

miguel_infra: hold — before drain, we should snapshot the GPU metrics and capture `nvidia-bug-report.sh` for HW team. I'll run preserver script and upload to s3 (s3://redwood-incident/1855001234/).

sara_oncall: go ahead miguel. raj proceed with cordon then graceful drain — prefer graceful to avoid cache loss. Leave one GPU worker if needed to flush caches.

raj_engineer: running now:
```bash
kubectl cordon gnode-12 && kubectl drain gnode-12 --ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=60 --timeout=600s
kubectl cordon gnode-13
```

ops-bot: Deploy hook: Redirecting 25% of traffic from route /v1/generate to warm-pool-us-west as canary.

emily_support: Messaging: drafting customer note now — short: "We are investigating increased request latency for generation endpoints. Traffic is being routed to healthy capacity; some customers may see degraded streaming performance. We'll update in 30m." csm_jordan, want me to send to dedicated customer list?

csm_jordan: yes please. include bullet about mitigation and ETA for next update. attach link to this thread.

miguel_infra: uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-incident/1855001234/nvidia_bug_report_gnode12.tar.gz and gnode13.tar.gz. Also captured dmesg and i2c sensor readings.

hw_oncall: looking. early read: corrected ECC count high and we have two uncorrected ECC events on gnode-12 GPU0. temps sustained at 90+C which can cause ECC flurries + occasional PCIe disconnects. suspect thermal throttling plus flaky GPU on gnode-12.

sara_oncall: thanks. priority: remove nodes from production rotation, escalate for RMA for failing GPU, and rebuild/replace nodes. For the short term, keep traffic on warm-pool and spin up extra ephemeral capacity to absorb load.

raj_engineer: drain completed for gnode-12, pods moved. cordon confirmed for gnode-13. gnode-14 still in rotation but showing high corrections; taking it to 10% traffic reduction.

incident-bot: Alert update: p99 latency dropped from 3.2s to 1.1s after traffic shift. p95 at 420ms. Remaining tail anomalies on long sequences (>2k tokens) while caches refill.

emily_support: sending customer note now. posted to customers@dedicated-list and to affected CSMs.

csm_jordan: ack, forwarded to key accounts with ETA 2h for hardware RMA completion and 24h for node rebuild.

miguel_infra: starting RMA ticket with vendor (NVIDIA partner). providing bug reports. also scheduling node reboot window off-peak in 30m for gnode-14 to try to clear persistent ECC counters; will notify if we see more uncorrected errors.

hw_oncall: recommendation: if uncorrected ECC > 0 after reboot, order replacement GPU. thermal profile shows insufficient airflow; check adjacent node fans and data center intake.

sara_oncall: handoff: I'm going offline in 20m. miguel_infra, please act as primary oncall for next 4h and update this thread with hardware/RMA status. raj_engineer, continue monitoring DR and traffic routing. emily_support and csm_jordan — keep customers updated every 60m or on material changes.

miguel_infra: ack, taking over. next update in 15m or earlier if RMA confirmed.

raj_engineer: continuing to watch streaming stalls. if we see repeated stalls on warm-pool, we'll temporarily reduce max seq length to 1024 for affected routes to limit tail latency.

ops-bot: Reminder: Runbook incident page created: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1855001234 (auto-generated).

emily_support: status page draft ready for ops review.

miguel_infra: update — after reboot of gnode-14, ECC corrected dropped to normal, no new uncorrected events so far. vendor ticket created, awaiting RMA auth for gnode-12 GPU0.

hw_oncall: following up with vendor. logging note: thermal throttling can accelerate ECC accumulation; long-term fix: improve airflow and firmware update scheduled next maintenance window.

sara_oncall: leaving final note: mitigations succeeded — SLOs recovered to normal. root cause probable GPU thermal degradation leading to ECC errors and occasional PCIe disconnects causing streamer stalls. follow-up: postmortem, vendor RMA, airflow check, and add alert for ECC uncorrected > 0 to escalate earlier.

miguel_infra: handoff complete, taking over watch. will update thread when RMA complete or if new errors appear.

csm_jordan: thanks all. customers notified.

incident-bot: Incident severity downgraded to Sev3 (mitigated).

sara_oncall: thanks team. great coordinated response. :heart:
